data.narrative:
Atomic AI is a Series A–stage biotech company founded by Raphael Townshend that has raised $42M to date. The valuation universe includes 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-sector comparables, including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, Chai Discovery, New Limit, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Given data constraints, only the Stage-Progression method is applicable. Using total capital raised as a proxy for post-money valuation ($42M) and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to the next financing round yields an implied valuation of $84M. Peer-Median analysis cannot be performed: while 8 same-sector private peers exist, filtering for stage, adjacency, and valuation tier yields fewer than the required 3 comparables. Public-Comp Anchoring is inapplicable because Atomic AI's revenue is not disclosed; the public Biotech & Health median P/S is 5.6x across the three tickers, but without a revenue figure, this metric cannot be deployed.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $71M (low) to $97M (high), with a median point of $84M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty around the appropriate step-up multiplier and the absence of sufficiently dense peer comps. Revenue disclosure or additional private peer data with comparable stage and capital profiles would strengthen conviction in this range.
